app.title: ELTIF Term Sheet Generator
app.subtitle: Term sheet and liquidity simulation for a Czech retail ELTIF

landing.headline: ELTIF Term Sheet Generator
landing.description: Build a structured term sheet and liquidity simulation for a Czech retail ELTIF — aligned with ELTIF 2.0 and RTS 2024/2759, for both SICAV and open-ended mutual fund structures.

advisories.antiDilutionRecommended: It is recommended to select at least one anti-dilution tool. You can still continue without selecting any.
advisories.noticeBelow3Months: A notice period shorter than 3 months requires notification and justification to the NCA (Art. 5(8) RTS 2024/2759).
advisories.frequencyMoreOftenThanQuarterly: Redemption frequency more often than quarterly requires justification to the NCA (Art. 5(4) RTS 2024/2759).
advisories.eligibleBelow55: Eligible assets are below the legal minimum of 55% of capital. You can continue — the term sheet will record this value.

submit.success: Term sheet was processed and sent.

submit.errorBody: Something went wrong while generating your term sheet. Please try again in a moment. If the problem continues, contact us.

simulation.title: Redemptions simulation
simulation.help: Interactive demo: based on the fund's settings, it calculates when and how much an exiting investor would actually receive — including when many people want to exit at once.
simulation.aggregateHint: Total demand on that payout day including this investor's request.
simulation.investorChoiceCarry: Carry remainder to next payout day
simulation.suspensionHint: Dealing days that fall inside the suspension window are skipped; the simulation moves to the next valid payout day. If the suspension does not overlap your schedule, results will not change.
simulation.suspensionActive: Suspension active — dealing days in this period are skipped.
simulation.notFullyExecuted: Request was not fully executed (remainder lapsed).
simulation.incompleteConfig: Complete required redemption and scenario fields to see the simulation.
